assets.title: Compact Parked Cargo Trailer
assets.description: Original S01/S06 static compact cargo trailer with one continuous open tub, a low supporting chassis, converging A-shaped drawbar, real vertical through-bored towing eye, two independently editable flat-tread tyre/hub assemblies, two raised mudguards with fixed brackets, and a grounded fixed parking leg. Four solid PBR materials, metre scale, source Z up, tow direction -Y. Ground origin is under the cargo tub centre; eye centre (0,-1.90,0.50) m with a 90 mm minimum clear bore along Z. Existing delivery van has no mating hitch; no host compatibility is claimed. One original reusable static prop, with no cargo or towing vehicle. No towing, animation, turning path, loading, braking, roadworthiness, stability, engineering, physics or safety certification.
